To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) the mdd-sPLSV method is able to deal with missing data in high-dimensional data, (ii) the method allows the imputation of missing values in a supervised setting, (iii) the method allows a better prediction of the response variables than the existing methods, (iv) the method is able to detect the most relevant variables in the data set, and (v) the method is easy to use and available on the CRan and pypi

we propose a new supervised multi-block method, based on PLS, that can be used for high-dimensional data with a large proportion of missing data, that can handle both missing data and variable selection and that is more accurate than the existing methods.
the proposed mdd-sPLs method, which combines variable selection and missing data imputation, outperforms other methods in terms of prediction error and variable selection.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development and application of a new supervised multi-block method, called mdd-sPLSL, for high dimensional data with missing values.
the development of supervised methods for the analysis of high dimensional multi-block incomplete data.
the development of new statistical tools to analyze high dimensional incomplete data.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
mdd-sPLs is a powerful and flexible tool for supervised analysis of incomplete high dimensional data.
the proposed method outperforms the existing ones for the prediction of the response variable and the imputation of the missing values.
mdd-sPLs outperforms the existing methods in terms of prediction error and is the only method to combine data imputation and variable prediction.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed a new method for the analysis of high-dimensional data with missing values.
we have introduced a novel method that allows for simultaneous data imputation, subspace selection and prediction of the response variable, while dealing with missing data.
we propose a novel approach for missing value imputation and variable selection in supervised multi-block high-dimensional settings.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the mdd-sPLs method is the most efficient supervised multi-block method to handle high dimensional data with missing values.
missing data imputation can be achieved in a supervised way, while preserving the predictive power of the method, which is crucial in the context of high-dimensional data.
supervised multi-block mddsPLS is a powerful method for the analysis of incomplete high dimensional data.
